## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the problem, what changes for players or contributors, and the related issue.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots and
the browser/viewport states you inspected. Distinguish emulation from physical devices.

## Review notes

Explain meaningful tradeoffs, dependency changes, documentation updates, or remaining
limits. Mention material tool assistance when useful. Maintainers review the exact
commit before dispatching CI on the local runner.
